reason: All 6 linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail identically with a conda solver error for cross-python_linux-riscv64, which does not exist yet as a package; every other platform (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, osx_64, osx_arm64, win_64) passes. This is a conda-forge packaging gap (missing cross-compilation support package), not a code bug in tornado, so the PR cannot merge green until cross-python publishes a riscv64 build.
